instruction: Collect the Best Long Paper Award winners from ACL Anthology for 2019-2022, including title, year, author names (comma-separated), and PDF URL, and enter this data in best_awards_acl.xlsx on the desktop, with years sorted descending.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires looking up ACL Best Long Paper Award winners from 2019-2022 and recording title, year, authors (comma-separated), and PDF URL in Excel with years sorted descending. Evaluator extracts all 4 columns from Excel file and verifies: (1) exactly 4 rows for years 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, (2) years are in descending order, (3) all fields (title, year, authors, PDF URL) are non-empty, (4) authors are comma-separated, (5) PDF URLs contain ACL domain or .pdf extension. Custom getter reads Excel file and extracts all columns, metric performs comprehensive validation with partial credit scoring.

llm_judge_reasons: Comprehensive verification coverage: Evaluator checks all instruction requirements (title, year, authors, PDF URL presence, year sorting)
Correct getter logic: Extracts all 4 columns (title, year, authors, pdf_url) from Excel file correctly

Complete metric validation: (1) Verifies exactly 4 rows for years 2019-2022, (2) Verifies years are [2022, 2021, 2020, 2019] in descending order, (3) Verifies all fields are non-empty, (4) Verifies authors are comma-separated, (5) Verifies PDF URLs contain ACL-related patterns
Proper parameter handling: Metric correctly accesses expected.get('expected_years') without the common 'rules' nesting error
Appropriate partial credit scoring: Returns normalized score (0.0-1.0) based on completeness, fails early if critical checks fail
Proper postconfig: Activates LibreOffice window and saves file with Ctrl+S before reading Excel data

Minor limitation: Cannot verify actual award data correctness (titles/authors/URLs matching real ACL awards) without hardcoded expected values, but this appears intentional for browser-based research tasks where format compliance is verified rather than data accuracy
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optional enhancement: Could add expected rules with actual award titles, authors, and URLs from ACL Anthology 2019-2022 to verify data correctness in addition to format compliance
Optional enhancement: Could make URL validation stricter (require 'aclanthology.org' domain specifically rather than accepting any URL with 'acl' or '.pdf')
